desc: Ideation: fix middle index i, split by cL/cR copies of nums[i], identify automatic cL+cR>=2 cases and the hard cL+cR=1 case.

Implement O(n^2) per-middle-index counting: coordinate-compress nums, sweep i while maintaining Lcnt/Rcnt, compute binomial automatic cases, and compute t=2 extra-x-left/right terms with distinct non-x pair totals and per-value exclusions modulo 10^9+7.

Verify against examples 1-3, all-equal, all-distinct, duplicate-heavy cases, and n=1000 performance; debug any t=2 distinctness or modulo-subtraction errors (manually confirmed examples: ex1=6, ex2=4 via t==2 case A/B contributions, ex3=0).
